actions.desc: When Dorrik hits with a melee weapon attack, expend a spell slot to deal radiant damage: 2d8 for a 1st-level slot (+1d8 per slot level above 1st, max +5d8). +1d8 extra against undead or fiends.

class_features.name: Divine Sense
class_features.desc: Sense celestials, fiends, and undead within 60 ft (not behind total cover) until end of next turn. Uses: 1 + Cha mod (1) = 1 per long rest.

class_features.name: Lay on Hands
class_features.desc: Pool of 20 HP. Restore HP or spend 5 HP to cure disease/poison. Refreshes on long rest.

class_features.name: Fighting Style — Defense
class_features.desc: +1 AC while wearing armor. Already included in AC total (19).

class_features.name: Divine Smite
class_features.desc: On a melee hit, expend a spell slot: 2d8 radiant (1st slot) +1d8 per level above 1st, max 5d8. +1d8 vs undead/fiends.

class_features.name: Sacred Weapon (Channel Divinity — Oath of Devotion)
class_features.desc: As an action, imbue one weapon with positive energy. For 1 minute: add Cha modifier to attack rolls with the weapon (minimum +1); weapon emits bright light 20 ft, dim light 20 ft further; weapon becomes magical if not already. Ends early if Dorrik is incapacitated or sheathes the weapon.

class_features.name: Turn the Unholy (Channel Divinity — Oath of Devotion)
class_features.desc: As an action, present your holy symbol. Each fiend or undead within 30 ft that can see or hear you must make a DC 10 Wisdom save or be turned for 1 minute. Turned: must move away, can't take reactions, can only Dash or escape. Ends if it can't move away or takes damage.

class_features.name: Oath of Devotion Tenets — DM NOTE
class_features.desc: Honesty, Courage, Compassion, Honour, Duty. This is a rigid oath — Dorrik holds himself and everyone around him to strict standards of good. Watch for moments that might tempt him to break it (deception, allowing harm to innocents, acting dishonourably for a good outcome). Breaking the oath risks becoming an Oathbreaker Paladin.

class_features.name: ASI / Feat (Level 4)
class_features.desc: Ability score improvement or feat taken at level 4 — not specified in source data. Con went from 17 → 18 suggesting +1 Con, possibly paired with +1 Wis or a feat like War Caster / Resilient.

traits.name: Chef (Feat)
traits.desc: +1 Con (included in stats). Proficiency with Cook's Utensils. Replenishing Meal: during a short rest, up to 4+PB creatures spending Hit Dice each heal +1d8. Bolstering Treats: create PB treats per day, each granting PB temporary HP for 8 hours.

traits.name: Rock Gnome
traits.desc: Darkvision 60 ft. Gnome Cunning: advantage on Int/Wis/Cha saving throws against magic. Artificer's Lore: double proficiency on History checks about magic, tech, or alchemy. Tinker: construct tiny clockwork devices.

traits.name: Harvest the Water (Fisher Background)
traits.desc: Advantage on fishing checks. Can sustain a modest lifestyle by fishing and feed up to 10 people per day near water.

traits.name: Personality
traits.desc: Trait: My friends are my crew — we sink or float together. Ideal: Daring — the richest bounty goes to the bold. Bond: The gods saved me in a storm; I owe them my life. Flaw: A hard life makes empathy difficult.

goals: Protect his companions like his crew
Honour the paladin who died saving him
Help Rock Gnome villages threatened by kobolds
backstory:
Dorrik grew up in Pebble-Push, a village between a large cave and the ocean. His family were the village's front-line defenders against kobold raids and he was destined to carry the family shield. He had a natural talent for cooking and fishing.

When travelling paladins passed through, Dorrik fed them fish in exchange for stories. That night a massive kobold assault hit the village. Dorrik fought but nearly died — saved by the paladins, though one died protecting him. The paladins left him a book on their faith.

Years later, out on a fishing charter, a freak storm struck. Dorrik saw a light in the clouds — a divine sign. He guided his crew to safety. Returning home they found Pebble-Push in flames, a planned kobold attack timed for the village's weakest moment. They fled.

Dorrik sought the paladins' church and swore his Oath of Devotion. He became known as one of the only Rock Gnome paladins and beloved in the kitchen. When dwarf soldiers came through to retake Pebble-Push, Dorrik joined them. They wiped out the kobolds. He then continued with the dwarves toward another Rock Gnome settlement, determined to protect his kind.
notes: Level 4 update: HP up to 44, Con increased to 18 (+4 mod), now has 3 spell slots and 5 prepared spells including Thunderous Smite and Bless. Has acquired the Moonthistle Morningstar (magic weapon). Lay on Hands pool is now 20 HP. Channel Divinity (Sacred Weapon / Turn the Unholy) unlocked at level 3 — 1 use per short or long rest. Currently on 15/44 HP — note to heal before next session. Spell save DC 10 and spell attack +2 remain low (Cha 10). His strength is melee frontline + smites + healing support, not spellcasting.
